shellCommands.command: find /workspace -maxdepth 1 -iname "next.config*" -o -maxdepth 1 -iname "tsconfig*" | xargs -I{} echo {}; cat /workspace/next.config.* 2>/dev/null; echo "---tsconfig---"; cat /workspace/tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null

grep -R "\"after\"" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/web/exports/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -R "export.*after" /workspace/node_modules/next/server.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat /workspace/node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/web/exports/ 2>/dev/null | grep -i after

grep -RIn "cacheComponents\|dynamicIO" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/build/swc/generated-native.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -RIln "use cache.*not enabled\|cacheComponents is not enabled\|requires.*cacheComponents" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/build/*.js 2>/dev/null | head
npx tsc --noEmit --explainFiles 2>&1 | grep -B2 -A2 "page.tsx(15"; echo "---"; npx tsc --noEmit --traceResolution 2>&1 | grep -A5 "Resolving module 'next/server'" | head -40
(npx next start -p 3411 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 3; curl -s http://localhost:3411/ | head -60; echo "---log---"; cat /tmp/next-start.log

HTML=$(curl -s http://localhost:3411/); ACTION_ID=$(echo "$HTML" | grep -o '\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]*' | head -1 | sed 's/\$ACTION_ID_//'); echo "action id: $ACTION_ID"
time curl -s -o /tmp/action-resp.txt -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST "http://localhost:3411/" \
  -H "Next-Action: $ACTION_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=X" \
  --data-binary $'--X\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="1"\r\n\r\n[]\r\n--X--\r\n'
echo "---response head---"; head -c 300 /tmp/action-resp.txt; echo
pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; true

(npx next start -p 3412 > /tmp/next-start2.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 3
HTML=$(curl -s http://localhost:3412/)
FIELD=$(echo "$HTML" | grep -o 'name="\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/name="//; s/"//')
echo "field: $FIELD"
time curl -s -o /tmp/action-resp2.txt -w "\nHTTP_CODE:%{http_code}\n" -X POST "http://localhost:3412/" \
  -H "Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=X" \
  --data-binary $"--X\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"$FIELD\"\r\n\r\n\r\n--X--\r\n"
echo "---resp---"; cat /tmp/action-resp2.txt | head -c 500; echo
echo "---server log---"; cat /tmp/next-start2.log

HTML=$(curl -s http://localhost:3412/)
FIELD=$(echo "$HTML" | grep -o 'name="\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/name="//; s/"//')
printf -- '--X\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="%s"\r\n\r\n\r\n--X--\r\n' "$FIELD" > /tmp/body.txt
time curl -s -o /tmp/action-resp3.txt -w "\nHTTP_CODE:%{http_code}\n" -X POST "http://localhost:3412/" \
  -H "Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=X" \
  --data-binary @/tmp/body.txt
echo "---resp---"; cat /tmp/action-resp3.txt | head -c 500; echo
echo "---server log---"; tail -20 /tmp/next-start2.log

sleep 2; tail -10 /tmp/next-start2.log
pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "npx next start" 2>/dev/null; true
